discussion_comments.comment_body: Fixed in `cbb90fdf0f`. Since the DCR stores `abx_body`/`abx_metadata` as JSON strings (`tostring(...)`), these queries now use the DCR-flattened columns instead of dot-access: `abx_metadata_event_type_s` (all tables) and `abx_body_abx_body_case_status_s` (Case). Threat logs have no `severity` field, so that sample now breaks down by `abx_body_abx_body_attack_type_s`. The same fix was applied to the connectivity verification query.
Better to keep DetectionList dynamic type since it is a list.
Changed the type to dynamic and testing the latest changes in sentinel
